# GenOffice Insert Function source migration

Fixed upstream ref: `f8c17004fb730df11f0f743164ffd8b4281bb38c`, https://github.com/genspark-ai/genoffice (local checkout `/home/junge/pros/genoffice-source-full`). Apache-2.0; original LICENSE and NOTICE retained here. SOURCE-SHA256.json keys are relative to the upstream repository; LOCAL-SHA256.json keys are relative to this frontend directory.

This is a direct source migration, not a small handcrafted function picker. `workbook-function-arguments.ts` retains all pure helpers; `workbook-function-catalog.ts` retains registry descriptions/category mapping/syntax and source fallback merge. `workbook-function-{flow,catalog-dialog,arguments-dialog}.tsx` retain the complete two-step React source, all fallback entries, search, Recent, categories, parameters, repeat rows, call editing, previews and floating grid range picking. `workbook-modal-dialog.ts` retains the source focus lifecycle. `workbook-function-history.ts` extracts only source history helpers; `workbook-function-i18n.ts` extracts the referenced Chinese source strings. Native select replaces the desktop Dropdown. Independent scoped CSS maps the source dialog styles onto Office colors without changing global selectors.

`workbook-function-runtime.ts` adapts source current-workbook editor/caret capture, serial Univer executeFormulas previews, pointer-armed range picks and cancel restoration; captured native workbook/sheet core identity plus editable/protection checks prevent late writes. `workbook-insert-function.tsx` hosts React, opens lazily, guards repeated/pending opens, and owns the native formula-bar fx subscription and disposal. It does not implement a calculator.

Remaining host gap: external-workbook links/tabs and cross-window range picking require upstream desktopApi (listExternalLinks/listWorkbookTabs/armWorkbookPick). The browser editor has no such host (also documented in workbook-vendor/SOURCE.md). Source external-pick UI/types are retained, the local host exposes no external targets and an explicit unavailable error if invoked; this is not claimed as implemented or excluded from full parity. Current-workbook insertion/evaluation/save/reopen is the scope verified here. Function catalog availability does not claim all source numerical overrides or all Excel functions are equivalent.

Browser fx adaptation: Univer 0.25.1 sheets-ui FormulaEditorController._listenFxBtnClick opens a cell editor using the formula-bar DOCS unit; EditingRenderController then issues sheet selections with that DOCS unit on Escape, causing ActiveWorksheetController.getActiveSheet to fail. The local host captures only clicks within the mounted formula-bar fx span (including its padding), opens the migrated flow and releases capture on disposal. Other icons, formula input and keys remain native. The source fx service subscription is retained for compatibility; arbitrary programmatic service emissions are not verified safe against the native controller and are not a supported local product entry. Source Shift+F3 dispatches insert-function-open directly rather than emitting the fx service. No native service methods are patched.

Registry verification found all 61 fallback catalog names have native executors. This does not cover the upstream numerical/runtime overrides (RATE bisection, CELL desktop filename and MINIFS/MAXIFS empty-set behavior); these remain separately tracked engine parity work.


Numerical/runtime override migration (next batch, integration verification ongoing): `workbook-function-cell.ts`, `workbook-function-rate.ts` and `workbook-function-ifs.ts` adapt the fixed source `cell-function.ts`, `rate-function.ts`, `ifs-empty-set.ts`. CELL delegates non-filename queries to the captured native executor; its path comes from the authenticated native context or the percent-encoded report file response header, not an inferred browser URL. RATE reuses the native parameter/array/error pipeline and adds only the source bisection fallback after #NUM!. MINIFS/MAXIFS retain native criteria calculation and replace the source empty-set artifact with numeric zero. Install once after first workbook creation and force recalculation while loading; a source-compatible zero-delay registration recheck is retained with disposal and ownership guards. These adapters do not assert all numerical or external-workbook parity.

2026-11-10 criteria compare cache alignment: `workbook-function-criteria.ts` follows fixed-ref `apps/sheets/src/renderer/criteria-compare-cache.ts` for numeric-coerced equality criteria against imported text columns. A local shared prototype lease keeps the patch active across simultaneous workbook runtimes and restores it when its last owner disposes. Real imported text-month repeated SUMIFS, keyboard edits, draft recovery, Python save and revision reopen are covered by `workbook-function-criteria-gui-smoke.mjs`; these checks do not assert all function semantics are aligned.
